dex: DEXs are Decentralized Exchanges. Like frog ponds where trades happen P2P with smart contracts, no gatekeepers! 🐸
cex: CEXs are Centralized Exchanges. Easier to use but they hold your coins. Not your keys? Not your tadpoles! 🐸
impermanent loss: That's what happens when you provide liquidity, and prices move. Like offering flies, then losing some while they wriggle! 🐸
arbitrage: Buy low here, sell high there. Frogs hopping from lily pad to lily pad for profit! 🐸
